build_classification_task: build a ClassificationTask from config using build_task and prepare it for training
test_checkpointing: test checkpointing by comparing task states before and after training phases
test_gradient_clipping: test gradient clipping by setting clip_grad_norm and verifying gradient norms after training
test_gradient_accumulation: test gradient accumulation by comparing simulated batch size results with actual batch size results
test_stateful_loss: test a custom stateful loss registered with register_loss and verify it appears in classy state
